shortDescription: Execute CLI commands on Comware 7 devices

options.name: command
options.description: String (single command) or list of commands to be executed on the device.  Sending a list requires YAML format to be used in the playbook.

options.name: file_txt
options.description: Text file on server. Include file path and file name.

options.name: type
options.description: State whether the commands are display (user view) or configure (system view) commands.  Display and show are the same thing.
